requirements.title: Finding Auto-Capture Policy — L3 Auto, L2 Opt-In, L0/L1 Never
requirements.description: Enforce a tiered finding capture policy: L3 research runs auto-capture findings by default (no opt-in required); L2 fetch+synthesize runs capture findings only when an explicit --capture flag is passed; L0 (live search) and L1 (snippet synthesis) runs never persist findings. At the end of an L3 run (or L2 with capture), an LLM distillation pass processes the run output and emits structured findings (claim + citations + confidence score) which are then written to the findings store.

validation.notes: L0 live-search path has no finding-write code path (static analysis / code path test)
L1 synthesis path has no finding-write code path (static analysis / code path test)
L2 without --capture flag: distillation pass is not invoked and zero findings are written
L2 with --capture flag: distillation pass is invoked and findings count in database increases
L3 run: distillation pass is invoked automatically at run end and at least one finding is written
Distillation output schema validation: each emitted finding has claim (non-empty string), citations (array, min 1), and confidence (float in [0,1])

Run a complete L3 agent cycle and verify findings are present in the database post-completion without any explicit capture flag [ATTENDED live validation — needs a full agent-manager research run; the monthly runbook scripts/live-validate.sh kicks an L3 run with no capture flag, asserts a findings-count delta with source=L3, and logs evidence via `test-genie requirements manual-log --expires-in 30` (30-day TTL, honest regression on lapse)]
Run an L2 query without --capture and verify the findings database row count is unchanged
Run an L2 query with --capture and verify new findings rows are present with correct provenance linking to the L2 run
L3 research runs automatically build up the findings knowledge base without requiring operators to manually capture findings
L0/L1 paths remain stateless and do not accumulate data in the findings store
